title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Farmer
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Farmer. A class to describe a SAREF4AGRI farmer as a subclass of foaf:Person (FOAF vocabulary, not modeled here). See the ex:J._Jansen / ex:H._Jansen example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1, Figure 6: both are Farmer instances, members (foaf:member, reused here as the generic s4agri:isMemberOf relation in the example) of the FarmHolding ex:Jansen_and_Sons, which manages the Farm ex:Farm_Jansen_and_Son_Eindhoven.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Farmer'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. foaf:name (standard FOAF property on foaf:Person, inherited, not re-declared by SAREF4AGRI). The farmer's name, e.g. 'J. Jansen'.

managesFarm.description: Relationship. s4agri:managesFarm some Farm. 'A relation to represent the person or company that supervises a farm.' The farm(s) this farmer manages.

isMemberOf.description: Relationship. Reuses s4agri:isMemberOf (also used generically for foaf:member in the ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1 Farmer/FarmHolding example, Figure 6) to relate a Farmer to the FarmHolding they belong to.
